verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature, account-level data download, or open-format export path. Snapshots save disk state only for reuse inside Runloop, and file operations, SSH and storage objects are adjacent building blocks a user could assemble into a manual workaround, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
